actions.label: What to do
actions.wait: Wait until the running operation finishes, then try again.
actions.pickRepoRoot: Pick the repository root — the folder that contains the .git directory.
actions.relocate: Locate the moved folder, or archive the project.
actions.fixAccess: Change the write permissions on the folder or file, then try again.
actions.fixTarget: Fix the target path so it is a regular file inside the project root.
actions.pasteMarkerBlock: Paste a fresh marker block into the file (Copy marker block).
actions.reencode: Re-encode the file as UTF-8, then run the sync again.
actions.fixCauseAndRetry: Fix the cause described in the error and try again.
actions.freeSpace: Free up space on the volume, then try again.
actions.closeAndRetry: Close the program that holds the file, then try again.
actions.restoreFromBackup: Run the sync again; if the file stays damaged, restore it from the backup in the data directory.
actions.removeMarkerLine: Remove the reserved marker line from the text.
actions.fixField: Fix the invalid field, then save again.
actions.dbRecovery: Pick a database copy on the recovery screen, or start with an empty database.
actions.updateApp: Update the app to a newer version.
actions.installPreviousVersion: Install the previous app version, or update to a fixed release. The pre-migration copy of the database is at {backup_path}.

details.copiedAnnouncement: Error details copied to the clipboard.
